description.en: Adds the typesafe platform (POST /v1/systemone, the TypeSafe Jev API) and its API key account type. Requests are forwarded to TypeSafe as they are; usage is read from each answer's usage. The plugin builds the upstream requests; the core sends them, so the plugin itself makes no network connection. Model prices are set by administrators in the core.
description.zh: 新增 typesafe 平台（POST /v1/systemone，TypeSafe 的 Jev 接口）及其 API Key 账号类型。请求原样转发给 TypeSafe，用量取自每次应答的 usage。插件构造上游请求，由核心发送，插件自身不发起任何网络连接。模型价格由管理员在核心中配置。

description.en: A TypeSafe API key. Requests go to <Base URL>/v1/systemone (default https://api.typesafe.ai) with the key in Authorization: Bearer.
description.zh: TypeSafe 的 API Key。请求发往 <Base URL>/v1/systemone（默认 https://api.typesafe.ai），Key 放在 Authorization: Bearer 中。

reason.en: Register the typesafe platform and its TypeSafe API key account type
reason.zh: 注册 typesafe 平台及其 TypeSafe API Key 账号类型

reason.en: Serve the TypeSafe Jev API at POST /v1/systemone, the path of the official TypeSafe API
reason.zh: 在 POST /v1/systemone 上提供 TypeSafe 的 Jev 接口，与 TypeSafe 官方路径一致
